use_case: Machine learning credit underwriting model for consumer unsecured personal loans and credit cards in digital and branch channels: probability of default, approve, decline, or refer recommendation, amount or line, and top 4 reason codes
vendor_or_model: Bank-built gradient-boosted model on the machine learning platform (Cloud provider B), version 2.1
data_categories: Consumer report attributes from two consumer reporting agencies; stated and verified income; debt-to-income; deposit cash-flow data for existing customers (customer information and NPI). Excluded by design: age, ZIP code, and any prohibited basis
human_in_the_loop: Clear approvals within policy cutoffs are automatic; every decline recommendation is reviewed by an underwriter before the notice goes out; refer-band applications are underwritten manually
applicable_laws: ECOA and Regulation B (12 CFR 1002.4, 1002.6, 1002.9); FCRA (15 U.S.C. 1681m(a)); GLBA and the Interagency Guidelines (12 CFR 30 App. B); CFPB supervision (12 U.S.C. 5515)
status: In production (personal loans since 2026-03-02); pilot (credit cards, 15% of digital applications since 2026-07-06)
model_risk_scope: SR 26-2 model risk guidance (in scope); validated by Model Risk Management 2026-02
fair_lending_or_bias_testing: Personal loans tested 2026-04 and after version 2.1 (2026-06); credit card segment not yet tested (POAM-022)
monitoring: Monthly population stability and approval rates; quarterly fair lending metrics; override and reason code reviews
